clue.text: Occasionally, magnet being near aerial …

indicators.note: occasionally means only now and then, so take every other letter of the phrase magnet being near

parts.note: the even letters are taken from these three words

explanation.surface: A magnet placed close to a TV aerial, trailing off into the next clue.
explanation.walkthrough: The ellipsis links this clue to 5 across in surface only; the wordplay is complete here.
explanation.definitionFit: An aerial is the rod or wire that picks up radio and television signals, the same thing under its other common name.

clue.text: Ultimately Michelle Obama abandoned a simple life

indicators.note: abandoned means wild and unrestrained, so the letters are rearranged
ultimately means the last letter of Michelle

parts.note: its last letter is E

explanation.surface: Michelle Obama finally gave up the White House for a plain existence.
explanation.definitionFit: An amoeba is a single-celled organism, about the most basic form of living thing.

clue.text: Narrator describing short party for tourist

indicators.note: describing means drawing around, so the teller word goes around the shortened party

parts.note: a teller of a story is a narrator

indicators.note: short means the party word loses its last letter

parts.note: a rave is a party

explanation.surface: A storyteller recounting a brief party for a holidaymaker.
explanation.definitionFit: A traveller is a person on a journey, and a tourist is someone visiting places on holiday.

clue.text: Not raising Republican's spirit

indicators.note: raising means the Republican letter moves up in this down entry

parts.note: never means not at all
R is the abbreviation for Republican

explanation.surface: A Republican refusing to lift morale.
explanation.walkthrough: In NEVER the R moves up from the bottom to the middle of the down entry.
explanation.definitionFit: Nerve means courage or boldness, the same as spirit in the sense of pluck.

clue.text: Performance style of a place with lap dancing

indicators.note: dancing means the letters of place and lap move about

explanation.surface: Describing the kind of show put on at a lap-dancing venue.
explanation.definitionFit: A cappella singing is unaccompanied by instruments, a way of performing music.

clue.text: … may invert audiovisual signals — in extremis, seek support

parts.note: may and can both express permission

indicators.note: invert means turn the short form of audiovisual upside down, here read backwards
in extremis, at the extremes, means only the first and last letters of signals are used

parts.note: its outer letters are S and S

explanation.surface: Continuing the aerial clue: the aerial might flip the audiovisual signals, while someone desperately looks for help.
explanation.walkthrough: Read as one sentence with 1 across, the clue seems to be about reception. CAN plus VA plus SS gives the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: To canvass is to go round asking people for their votes or backing, which is seeking support.

clue.text: In hindsight, somewhat regret a contract's provision

indicators.note: in hindsight means looking backwards, so the run of letters is read in reverse
somewhat means only part of these words is used

parts.note: the letters run across these words

explanation.surface: Looking back, a contract clause is slightly regretted.
explanation.walkthrough: Provision is a verb here: to provision is to supply.
explanation.definitionFit: To cater is to supply food or what is needed, and to provision is likewise to equip with supplies.

clue.text: Oddly light engine flying into LAX

indicators.note: flying means moving freely, so the letters are mixed up
oddly means the odd-numbered letters of light

parts.note: its odd letters are L, G, T

explanation.surface: A light aircraft engine heading into Los Angeles airport.
explanation.walkthrough: LAX looks like the Los Angeles airport code; it is the plain adjective meaning careless.
explanation.definitionFit: Being lax means careless about duties or standards, which is the meaning of negligent.

clue.text: Oven, hot once more

parts.note: an Aga is a British range cooker
in can mean hot, fashionable

explanation.surface: An oven being hot for a second time.
explanation.walkthrough: An Aga is a heavy cast-iron range cooker common in British kitchens.
explanation.definitionFit: Again means a second time, repeating something, the same as once more.

clue.text: Information at this point builds discipline

parts.note: the SP, short for starting price, is slang for the inside information
here means at this point

explanation.surface: Knowing what's what at this stage helps develop self-control.
explanation.walkthrough: In British slang the SP is the essential information about something.
explanation.definitionFit: A sphere is a field of study or activity, and a discipline is a branch of learning.

clue.text: Broadcasting touching song

parts.note: on can mean in contact with, touching
an air is a tune or song

explanation.surface: A moving song is being played on the radio.
explanation.definitionFit: A programme that is on air is being transmitted live, so the phrase describes the state of being broadcast.

clue.text: Some people want this from a star sign

definitions.text: Some people want this from a star
definitions.meaning: first meaning: what a fan asks a celebrity for, a signature
second meaning: as a verb, to write one's name on something

explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests astrology, a star sign; split it after star and the second part is a verb.
explanation.definitionFit: A celebrity's signature is what fans collect, and to put your signature on a photo is to do exactly that act.

clue.text: Magistrate told phone company salesman on the counter he should care for workers

indicators.note: told means spoken, so the slang word for a magistrate is taken by its sound

parts.note: beak is British slang for a magistrate
EE is a British mobile phone network

indicators.note: on the counter means running counter, going the opposite way, so the short word for a salesman is read backwards

parts.note: a rep is a sales representative

explanation.surface: A magistrate tells the phone company that its salesman behind the counter ought to look after the staff.
explanation.walkthrough: Beak is British slang for a magistrate; it is said aloud to give BEEK. EE is a UK phone network. The workers are worker bees.
explanation.definitionFit: Worker bees are the hive's labourers, so a person whose job is tending hives looks after workers.

clue.text: Spiritual learner wanting to pray

indicators.note: wanting means lacking, so the letters meaning to pray are removed from the learner

parts.note: a beginner is a learner
to beg is to pray or plead

explanation.surface: A novice in a religious life who wishes to say prayers.
explanation.definitionFit: The inner life is the spiritual or mental one, as opposed to outward physical existence.

clue.text: Massage back, squeezing large spot

indicators.note: squeezing means the reversed massage word holds the abbreviation for large inside it
back means the word for massage is read in reverse

parts.note: to rub is to massage
L is the clothing-size abbreviation for large

explanation.surface: A masseur rubs someone's back and presses on a big pimple.
explanation.walkthrough: BUR, the reversal, takes L after its first letter. Spot is a noun here, a smudge or smear.
explanation.definitionFit: A blur is a smear or smudge of indistinct marking, so a mark or spot on something can be called one.

clue.text: Tackle part to support graduate's performance

indicators.note: to support means to sit below, so the part word comes under the graduate in this down entry

parts.note: rig and tackle both mean gear or equipment
an MA is a Master of Arts, a graduate
a role is a part in a play

explanation.surface: A piece of kit holding up a graduate's stage turn.
explanation.definitionFit: A rigmarole is a tediously long-winded procedure, a palaver, which colloquially is a performance.

clue.text: Perhaps Armitage Shanks's third feature stops stool at opening in enamel

indicators.note: stops means plugs, so that letter goes inside the decoy word

parts.note: a stool pigeon is a decoy, a lure

indicators.note: the third feature, or letter, of Shanks is picked out

parts.note: the third letter of Shanks is A

indicators.note: opening in means the first letter of enamel

parts.note: its first letter is E

explanation.surface: Armitage Shanks makes toilets, so the clue seems to describe a toilet seat set into an enamel bowl.
explanation.walkthrough: Armitage Shanks is a British bathroom brand, but Simon Armitage is the UK Poet Laureate. A stool pigeon is a decoy, so stool gives LURE.
explanation.definitionFit: Simon Armitage holds the post of Poet Laureate, so he is one example of the title.

clue.text: United with revolutionary Tamil Tigers' leader in occupation — hesitation creates threat

indicators.note: in occupation means occupying, so the leading letter sits inside the rearranged word
revolutionary means turning over, so the letters of Tamil are rearranged
leader means the first letter of Tigers

parts.note: its first letter is T
um is the sound of hesitation

explanation.surface: A political report on the Tamil Tigers' rebellion, ending with a hesitant ultimatum.
explanation.walkthrough: TAMIL is rearranged as LIMAT, and T goes in after the L.
explanation.definitionFit: An ultimatum is a final demand backed by the warning of consequences, making it a threat.

clue.text: Bluth upset with main form of digital protection?

indicators.note: upset means knocked over, so the letters are reordered

explanation.surface: The setter, Bluth, is annoyed by the main kind of computer security.
explanation.walkthrough: Digital means of the fingers, not computing: a nail shields the fingertip.
explanation.definitionFit: The nail on the thumb covers and shields the tip of a digit, so it is one way a finger is protected.

clue.text: Humphrey is making ordinary jazz style one to show off

indicators.note: is making means the ordinary letter in the actor's surname is turned into the jazz style

parts.note: Humphrey Bogart, the film star
rag, or ragtime, is an early jazz style

explanation.surface: The actor Humphrey Bogart dumbing down a jazz style.
explanation.definitionFit: A braggart boasts loudly about himself, a person who likes to show off.

clue.text: Speaker's educated and stiff

indicators.note: the speaker's version means the word is said aloud, giving a word that sounds the same

parts.note: taught means educated

explanation.surface: A public speaker is well schooled but rather formal.
explanation.definitionFit: Taut describes something pulled tight and rigid, like a rope under tension, so it is stiff.

clue.text: Friend missing in tea dance

indicators.note: missing means the friend word lacks the letters of in

parts.note: china, from rhyming slang china plate for mate, means friend
cha is slang for tea

explanation.surface: A pal is absent from the tea dance.
explanation.walkthrough: China plate is Cockney rhyming slang for mate; cha (or char) is British slang for tea.
explanation.definitionFit: The cha-cha is a Latin American ballroom routine.

clue.text: Direct debits for accommodation

indicators.note: direct as a verb means to arrange or steer, so the letters are reorganised

explanation.surface: Paying for lodgings by direct debit.
explanation.walkthrough: A bedsit is a British term for a single rented room used for both living and sleeping.
explanation.definitionFit: A bedsitter is a one-room flat, a modest place to live.

clue.text: Beast an English Youth Hostel rejected

indicators.note: rejected means sent back, so the whole string is read in reverse

parts.note: YH is the abbreviation used for a youth hostel

explanation.surface: A wild animal is refused entry to an English youth hostel.
explanation.definitionFit: A hyena is a scavenging carnivorous animal of Africa and Asia, a wild creature.

clue.text: Drunken nuisance displays boredom

indicators.note: displays says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A tiresome drunk shows signs of being fed up.
explanation.definitionFit: Ennui is a French-derived word for listless weariness, a feeling of being bored.

clue.text: E tablet I'm circulating to order

indicators.note: circulating means moving around, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: E is taken as written; it ends the answer rather than joining the rearranged letters

explanation.surface: Handing round ecstasy tablets on demand.
explanation.walkthrough: E is slang for an ecstasy tablet, which makes the surface. The definition is the verb: to timetable things is to order them. The E stays put at the end.
explanation.definitionFit: To timetable events is to schedule them, putting them into a fixed sequence or arrangement.

clue.text: Plug in toy Minion

indicators.note: in means the plug goes inside the toy

parts.note: taken as written
an ad is a plug, a promotion

explanation.surface: Advertising inside a Minion toy, the yellow cartoon figures.
explanation.walkthrough: Minions are toy characters from the Despicable Me films, but here minion means a servile follower.
explanation.definitionFit: A toady is a fawning underling who flatters a superior, as a minion does.

clue.text: Moves from Argentina, making it after India

definitions.meaning: first meaning: the Argentine ballroom dance
second meaning: in the NATO phonetic alphabet India spells I, and this code word supplies T, together spelling it

explanation.walkthrough: The second part reads as getting on after a trip to India; it really means spelling the word it in radio code, I then T.
explanation.definitionFit: The tango is a dance from Buenos Aires, and also the radio code word for the letter T.

clue.text: Harmonious character

definitions.meaning: second meaning: a letter that is not a vowel

explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests a pleasant personality; the second definition is a written character.
explanation.definitionFit: Consonant means agreeing or in tune, and the word also names any letter such as B or T that is not a vowel.

clue.text: Approaches back of peloton, cycling behind

indicators.note: back of means the last letter of peloton

parts.note: its last letter is N

indicators.note: cycling means a letter is moved round from one end of the word to the other

parts.note: arse is British slang for the behind

explanation.surface: A rider at the back of the bike race pack gets closer, pedalling from the rear.
explanation.walkthrough: ARSE, British slang for the backside, has its last letter moved to the front to give EARS.
explanation.definitionFit: To near something is to get closer to it, which is what approaching means.

clue.text: Supply — with speed — see a lass run away first

indicators.note: first means the shortened lass phrase goes before the word for the see, though the clue names the see earlier
away means the run letter goes from the word for a lass

parts.note: a lass is a girl
R is the cricket abbreviation for run
Ely is a cathedral city, the see of a bishop

explanation.surface: A girl is seen running off in a hurry.
explanation.walkthrough: Supply here is supple turned into an adverb, not the word for provision. 'First' puts A GIL ahead of ELY, the see, a bishop's diocese.
explanation.definitionFit: Doing something nimbly and quickly, in a lithe or supple manner, is moving with agility.

clue.text: Dispute about returning non-starting oven — and this sort of evening's romantic?

indicators.note: about means the debating word goes around the rest

parts.note: moot as a verb means raise for dispute or debate

indicators.note: returning means the shortened oven word is read backwards
non-starting means the oven word loses its first letter

parts.note: a kiln is an oven for firing pottery

explanation.surface: An argument over a broken oven, ending in a question about romantic evenings.
explanation.walkthrough: Moot is used as a verb, to raise for debate; the potter's oven, not a kitchen one, is the piece that gets beheaded and turned round.
explanation.definitionFit: An evening lit by the moon is the classic setting for romance.
